why: removes 2 mixin injection handler(s): check each still applies somewhere, with the same effect
reviewed: (1.21.5, re-reviewed for EpicCoreAPI#32 from the 1.21.5 sources and javap of neoforge-21.5.98.jar) The inherited verdict (moved to CloudRendererMixin and the AFTER_SKY GlobalSkyboxHook, same effect) was not true on 1.21.5, so both handlers are restored in this overlay. renderClouds HEAD: 1.21.5's lambda$addCloudsPass$6 calls DimensionSpecialEffects.renderClouds and only on false CloudRenderer.render, so CloudRendererMixin alone never skipped a dimension drawing its own clouds; eca$skipOccludingClouds cancels that lambda at its renderClouds invoke (the clouds pass is added after addMainPass and addParticlesPass, so CloudGate.occlude, set from renderEntity, is final when it runs); CloudRendererMixin stays as a harmless second gate. renderSky TAIL: 1.21.5 renderLevel calls addSkyPass only when !isFoggyAt/!shouldCreateWorldFog, and addSkyPass adds no pass for POWDER_SNOW/LAVA, a sky-blocking effect or SkyType NONE, so the AFTER_SKY handler (which NeoForge dispatches only inside the sky lambda) never drew there though 1.21.1's TAIL did; and AFTER_SKY is dispatched after a custom renderSky returned true, where 1.21.1 returned before TAIL. eca$addGlobalSkyboxPass adds an eca_global_skybox pass on targets.main just before the addMainPass invoke, with renderLevel's second FogParameters local (FOG_SKY; locals 22 terrain, 23 sky), skipped when lambda$addSkyPass$13's renderSky returned true (eca$recordCustomSky; 1.21.4's name was $12) and, on a frame with no sky pass (foggy/boss-fog, SkyType NONE, a sky-blocking effect, lava/powder snow, where 1.21.5 never calls renderSky but 1.21.1 still asked it before the TAIL), when the dimension's DimensionSpecialEffects class overrides renderSky at all (the declaring class of its renderSky is neither DimensionSpecialEffects nor NeoForge's IDimensionSpecialEffectsExtension default, which 1.21.5 still has; cached per class); GlobalSkyboxHook.passOwned makes the AFTER_SKY handler stand down. Double rotation confirmed real: renderLevel does matrix4fstack.mul(frustumMatrix) before the frame graph, GlCommandEncoder sets ModelViewMat from RenderSystem.getModelViewMatrix() (that stack) on every LegacyGl/RenderType draw, and AFTER_SKY's getModelViewMatrix() is that same frustumMatrix, which the old hook also put on its PoseStack; render() now starts from identity. No RenderStateShard.MAIN_TARGET bind is needed on 1.21.5 (draws name their target). renderEntity HEAD/RETURN, isSectionCompiled HEAD and the renderLevel HEAD/RETURN handlers stay.
